name: TX-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Moran running with large fundraising edge
model.rationale: This is a heavily Republican East Texas seat where incumbent Nathaniel Moran holds a massive financial advantage and Democrat Yolanda Prince has raised almost nothing. Prediction markets price a Republican win near 96%, consistent with the district's fundamentals.
model.watch: A major scandal or unexpected incumbent retirement would be the only realistic path to shifting this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
TX-01 is a deeply Republican East Texas district, with a partisan lean of about 24 points toward the GOP. Incumbent Nathaniel Moran is running for reelection after clearing his primary, and he holds an overwhelming financial advantage, having raised nearly $1.8 million while Democrat Yolanda Prince has raised under $10,000 with almost no cash on hand. No outside groups are spending against Moran.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets price a Republican win at roughly 96 percent. With the incumbent entrenched and the challenger lacking resources, the seat is safely Republican, with only a nominal chance of an upset.
